confidence: Allen et al. 2011 (GPIH), a modern reconstruction, at 37 g a tael (rice, millet, oils, fuel), with the rural Beijing fuel store's cash rate. Salt and fish are Timkovski's Peking market list of 1821, in cash at his own 1,100 a tael; he does not say whether he counts the little string of 500 or the great string of 1,000. His cloth is by the piece of no stated size and is left out; his wood (6 cash a jin) is held, not used, beside Allen's fuel.

cash.note: 1,243 cash to the tael (rural Beijing 1820-1830, 1,159-1,329, at face count: the store's 95-99 cash a day then match Allen's 2.8 g). Beijing's capital cash passed two for one
